title: Energy Assistance Liaison Note: Pledges Counted Toward the Previous Payment Arrangements Bill by Pledging Agency
content:
*Energy assistance liaison note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

Energy assistance pledges recorded on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account in the month ending on the bill date count toward the previous bill, when the next installment is billed, according to the pledging agency:

- **Operation Round Up.** Where an Operation Round Up pledge was recorded in the month, the month's pledges — every pledge recorded in the month, from whichever agency — count at 100 percent (1.0) of their amount.
- **Other agencies only.** Where pledges were recorded in the month but none from Operation Round Up, they count at 50 percent (0.5) of their amount. The other pledging agencies on the account records are LIHEAP, county emergency assistance and the Salvation Army.
- **No pledge.** Where no pledge was recorded in the month, none counts.

| Pledges recorded in the month ending on the bill date | Share of the month's pledges counted |
|---|---|
| at least one from Operation Round Up | 100 percent of all of them |
| one or more, none from Operation Round Up | 50 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Hypothetical months**

- A LIHEAP pledge of $200.00 alone: $100.00 counts.
- A LIHEAP pledge of $200.00 and an Operation Round Up pledge of $50.00: $250.00 counts.
- A Salvation Army pledge recorded six weeks before the bill date and nothing in the month: nothing counts.
